The ACMS engagement brings these connected activities into a common digital environment.</p><p>MetaDesign Solutions’ scope for Delhi Arbitration Centre defines a cloud-hosted case management platform, an integrated e-filing system, and mobile applications. It covers the journey from initial filing and arbitrator appointment through proceedings, award, and case closure.</p><p>The supplied interface screens show the administrative workspace: a consistent environment for registering cases, maintaining professional directories, configuring fees, managing room sessions, and recording case progress.</p><div class="band"><h3>Designed around the people managing arbitration</h3><p>The scope provides role-based access for Centre administrators, arbitrators, parties, and advocates or authorised representatives.</p><div class="flow"><div><small>INTAKE</small>File &amp; register</div><div><small>PROCEEDINGS</small>Allocate &amp; manage</div><div><small>RESOLUTION</small>Award &amp; close</div></div></div></section><section id="challenges"><span class="eyebrow">02 / The challenge</span><h2>Coordinating cases, people, time, and fees.</h2><p>The requirements point to four core operational challenges that the platform is intended to address.</p><div class="challenges"><div class="challenge"><div class="num">01</div><h3>Keeping the case journey connected</h3><p>Link intake, party information, pleadings, hearings, orders, and awards across a configurable arbitration lifecycle.</p></div><div class="challenge"><div class="num">02</div><h3>Managing appointments and availability</h3><p>Coordinate arbitrator panels, assignment rules, conflicts of interest, and hearing schedules across stakeholders.</p></div><div class="challenge"><div class="num">03</div><h3>Handling complex fee rules</h3><p>Support claim-based fee slabs, administrative charges, collections, disbursements, and financial records.</p></div><div class="challenge"><div class="num">04</div><h3>Protecting sensitive case information</h3><p>Combine controlled access, traceable actions, secure infrastructure, and continuity planning for legal and financial data.</p></div></div></section><section id="solution"><span class="eyebrow">03 / The solution</span><h2>A structured administrative workspace.</h2><p>The screenshots show a shared sidebar, clear page headings, grouped forms, searchable records, and contextual actions. This consistent structure supports navigation between the platform’s operational modules.</p><div class="feature"><div class="feature-head"><span class="num">01</span><div><h3>Structured intake and case registration</h3><p>The referral form groups general information, arbitrators, and counsels into tabs. Claimant and respondent details use repeatable sections.
